analysis_notes: A query is repeated across models, variants and target settings; rows are not independent samples.
Question/source-document IDs are the resampling clusters. All638winners remain represented in mixed retrieval.
Regime is defined by original query language versus search collection language; generated output language does not redefine it.
Per-report saved macro metrics give equal weight to eligible settings, not equal weight to questions.
Empty target-language cohorts are recorded explicitly in settings and cohort_coverage, never scored as zero.
generation.parquet counts each query/method/output once, independent of models/settings. Do not sum per-query-row costs to estimate spend.
Costs are configured API estimates; local compute is unpriced. Recorded amortized timings are not measured end-to-end latency.
Null measurements remain null. Original mode added API cost/time are knownzero because that stage is disabled.
Translation token/request fields are joined from the exact generation artifact matching reportfingerprint/configuration/summary.
Saved selection includes original evidence/answers for audit; these were not inputs to translation/HyDEgeneration.

validation.identity_metric_note: Saved model outputs exhibit a small number of identity-ranking differences. These are retained and explicitly audited, not silently corrected.
